steps.name: 요소 2개 선택(목록 Ctrl+클릭)
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.querySelector('[data-sel="e02"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,ctrlKey:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return document.querySelectorAll('#tab-props .ellist [data-sel].on, #tab-props .ellist .sel').length >= 0 ? true : 'x'

steps.name: Ctrl+G → 묶음 1개 · 최상위 요소 1개
steps.js: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'g',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('#host > .rs-slide > .rs-el')]; const g=top.filter(e=>e.dataset.type==='group').length; return top.length===1 && g===1 ? true : 'top='+top.length+' groups='+g

steps.name: 묶음 자식 2개 렌더 · 속성 [묶음 풀기]
steps.js: const g=document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-type="group"]'); const kids=g.querySelectorAll(':scope > .rs-el').length; const btn=document.querySelector('[data-act="ungroup"]'); return kids===2 && btn ? true : 'kids='+kids+' btn='+!!btn

steps.name: 자식 클릭 → 묶음이 선택됨
steps.js: const kid=document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-type="group"] > .rs-el'); const r=kid.getBoundingClientRect(); kid.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+5,clientY:r.top+5,button:0})); document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return !!document.querySelector('[data-act="ungroup"]') ? true : 'not group'

steps.name: Ctrl+Shift+G → 풀기 · 최상위 2개
steps.js: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'G',ctrlKey:true,shiftKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('#host > .rs-slide > .rs-el')]; return top.length===2 && !top.some(e=>e.dataset.type==='group') ? true : 'top='+top.length

steps.name: 축소판 배지 요청/처리 - 복제 단추와 같은 높이
steps.js: const bd=document.querySelector('.thumb .bd'); const tb=document.querySelector('.thumb .tools button'); if(!bd) return 'no badge(ok if none)'; const a=bd.getBoundingClientRect().height, b=tb?tb.getBoundingClientRect().height:0; return a>=16 && a<=22 && (b===0 || Math.abs(a-b)<=2) ? true : 'badge='+a+' btn='+b

steps.name: 표+글머리 선택 뒤 Ctrl+G → 묶이지 않음(표·차트는 PPTX 묶음 불가 안내)
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.querySelector('[data-sel="e02"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,ctrlKey:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'g',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const top=[...document.querySelectorAll('#host > .rs-slide > .rs-el')]; return top.length===2 && !top.some(e=>e.dataset.type==='group') ? true : 'top='+top.length
